company_description: Colgate-Palmolive Company, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells consumer products in the United States and internationally. It operates through two segments: Oral, Personal and Home Care; and Pet Nutrition. The Oral, Personal and Home Care segment offers toothpaste, toothbrushes, mouthwash, bar and liquid hand soaps, shower gels, shampoos, conditioners, deodorants and antiperspirants, skin health products, dishwashing detergents, fabric conditioners, household cleaners, and other related items. This segment markets and sells its products under the Colgate, Palmolive, Darlie, elmex, hello, meridol, Sorriso, Tom's of Maine, EltaMD, Filorga, Irish Spring, Lady Speed Stick, PCA SKIN, Protex, Sanex, Softsoap, Speed Stick, Ajax, Axion, Fabuloso, Murphy, Soupline, and Suavitel brands to a range of traditional and eCommerce retailers, wholesalers, and distributors, as well as dentists and skin health professionals. It also offers pharmaceutical products for dentists and other oral health professionals. risks.title: Currency and Exchange Rate Fluctuation Risk
risks.summary: Exposure to foreign currency volatility represents a material risk to profitability and cash flows, particularly in emerging markets.
risks.score_rationale: With approximately two-thirds of net sales generated outside the United States and about 45% from emerging markets, the company is exposed to significant foreign currency and exchange rate volatility. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Global Trade and Tariff Risk
risks.summary: Major developments in global trade relations, including 2025 executive orders, threaten cost structure, material availability and profit margins.
risks.score_rationale: New U.S. tariffs, trade retaliation and renegotiation of trade agreements (notably USMCA) create inflationary pressures and macroeconomic volatility affecting raw material costs and market accessibility. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Geopolitical Risk and Regional Conflicts
risks.summary: Geopolitical risks, particularly in Russia and Ukraine, create supply chain challenges, raw material availability issues and cash repatriation difficulties.
risks.score_rationale: The war in Ukraine and related geopolitical tensions have impacted operations in the Eurasia region, though not material currently (1% of net sales), with persistent risks to supply chain and cash flow withdrawals. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Innovation and Product Development Risk
risks.summary: Identifying, developing and launching innovative new products involves considerable costs, and any new product may fail to generate sufficient interest to cover costs.
risks.score_rationale: Growth depends on the success of identifying, developing and launching innovative products. Any failure to innovate quickly or adapt products to changing consumer preferences could negatively affect sales. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Retail and Digital Transformation Risk
risks.summary: The retail landscape is evolving rapidly with automation requirements, algorithm-based pricing and compliance with new standards, requiring constant strategy adaptation.
risks.score_rationale: Rapid changes in the retail landscape, shifts in customer practices (destocking, AI-assisted pricing algorithms, delisting), and adaptation to omnichannel commerce threaten commercial performance if the company fails to adapt its strategy. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Intangible Asset Impairment Risk
risks.summary: Goodwill and intangible assets are exposed to impairment risks if operating performance falls short of projections, as observed with the Filorga unit.
risks.score_rationale: The company recorded an impairment charge of $794 million (after tax) in Q4 2025 on goodwill and intangible assets of its skin care business (Filorga) due to lower growth and weakened performance in China. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: Colgate-Palmolive recognizes AI as a key strategic capability in its 2030 strategy, aiming to lead in data, analytics and artificial intelligence. The company has increased its AI capabilities despite macroeconomic challenges.
evidence: The 2030 strategy identifies leadership in capabilities such as data, analytics and AI as a key element of accelerated growth initiatives.
The 2025 strategic plan includes capability increases in science-led innovation, digital, data, analytics and artificial intelligence.

events.title: Venezuela begins debt restructuring process as sanctions ease
events.body: Investing.com -- Venezuela announced Wednesday that it has started a comprehensive process to restructure its sovereign and state oil company debt, following the lifting of U.S. sanctions earlier this year.

events.title: Polestar CEO says high fuel prices drive EV demand
events.body: Investing.com -- Electric-vehicle maker Polestar said Thursday that rising fuel prices have shifted consumer focus from "range anxiety" to "pump anxiety" as a Middle East crisis drives up global energy costs.
